# Ordinary GEN Operator and Response Review

| Review point | Canonical r0.2 result |
| --- | --- |
| Frozen contribution | `a_pi = G_pi gamma_i` |
| Unsigned normalization | `Q_p = sum_{i in C_p} a_pi` |
| Member | `M_b(p) = [sum_{i in C_p} a_pi epsilon_b,d(i) Z_i^PTC]/Q_p` |
| Sign placement | Exactly once, only on `Z_i^PTC` for each admitted occurrence. |
| Frozen facts | Coefficients, occurrence membership, `Q_p`, WCS, projection, support, `coverage_cut`, response handling, validity, and every MAP-local gate. |
| Ordinary MAP comparator | All-`+1` operation `m_MAP`; retains ordinary MAP identity. |
| Operator relation | `R_b^fixed = A_MAP,Pi D_epsilon_b H_PTC^fixed` |
| Inline/materialized parity | Equivalent only for identical equation, occurrence membership, assignment, parent operator, and output domain. |
| Response parity | Required response companion receives identical occurrence membership and identical modifier exactly once under its owner-declared response operator. |
| Missing response | Typed unavailable; never a hidden signal subset. |
| Output ownership | Signed member is NOI realization, not ordinary MAP science. |

Normative authority is `SCI-NOI-EQ-001..007` and
